_comment: Structured entitlements compiled from each signed customer agreement in the data pack (see scripts/compile_contracts.py, which regenerates this file with an LLM pass over the agreement text; it is checked in so the app runs deterministically). Fields present here OVERRIDE policy_defaults.json for that account, per Support Policy v3 §1 source precedence. Fields absent fall through to the defaults.

sla.source_clause: Northstar Enterprise Agreement §1 (Support terms) - replaces standard support-policy targets

cancellation.notes: Northstar may cancel any BOOKED shipment before pickup with no cancellation fee, regardless of how long ago it was booked. Once PICKED_UP, the standard return-to-origin process applies.

service_credit.notes: Unless the agreement states otherwise, the current ParcelPilot service-credit SOP applies. Monthly aggregate credits are capped at INR 5,000.

sla.coverage_notes: No weekend or after-hours support coverage.

service_credit.source_clause: LumenWorks Service Agreement §3 (Failed-pickup credits) - replaces the default credit amount and timing threshold in the SOP
